notes.key_messages:
To succeed in this paper candidates need to have completed full syllabus coverage, remember necessary
formulae, show all necessary working clearly and use a suitable level of accuracy.
notes.general_comments:
There were a number of instances of rounding answers to an inappropriate degree of accuracy and the use
of 2 significant figures for answers and working was an issue. In working, it is recommended that figures are
kept as accurate as possible. Many candidates know how to reach the answer from their calculators but in
most questions they will be expected to show some working. Where working was shown, in many cases it
was difficult to follow so candidates should try to set it out logically.
